clues.text: Samson gave his father and mother some of this to eat but never told them where he had found it.
At Mahanaim, Barzillai and others brought David's hungry people beans, lentils, curds, cheese, and this.
Preaching in the wilderness of Judea, John the Baptist, dressed in camel's hair, lived on this, found wild.
In the law of grain offerings, this, like leaven, was never to be burned as a food offering to the LORD.
Sending his sons back to Egypt, Israel had them carry balm, spices, myrrh, pistachios, almonds, and a little of this.
Back from forty days exploring Canaan, the spies told Moses the land truly flowed with milk and this.
A proverb warns that if you find this, eat only what you need, lest you have too much and vomit.
